changelog:
alibabacloud-bailian-video-creator v0.0.1

- Initial release of an AI video creation skill built on Alibaba Cloud DashScope.
- Supports text-to-video, image-to-video, reference-to-video, video editing, and video understanding using models like wan2.6-t2v, wan2.6-i2v, wan2.6-r2v-flash, wanx2.1-vace-plus, and qwen3.5-plus.
- Outlines feature selection logic based on user input and intent, with a decision tree for guidance.
- Emphasizes strict API Key management, secure credential handling, and direct script invocation.
- Documents orchestration and invocation flows for both synchronous and asynchronous video tasks.
